challengePass.reason: Diagnostics/replay candidates need a genuine failure or controlled crash; adding them before proof would be tooling churn. The active systemd isolation differential is the highest-value executable experiment.

nextExperiments: Finish PR #64 exact-head CI and inspect live isolation assertions plus median/p95 metrics.
Then run bounded failure-only strace on one controlled opaque process failure.
Native pipeline: ProcDump core -> GDB 17.2, with eu-stack comparator.
Minidump pipeline: Electron/Chromium Crashpad .dmp -> rust-minidump; never feed ELF cores to it.
Use rr only after a genuine intermittent Linux failure exists.
guardrails: No product isolation support is advertised from the experiment PR.
Required isolation protections fail closed; no silent downgrade.
Crash/replay tooling stays optional and raw artifacts remain authoritative.
No target/data/evidence/fidelity caps or weaker tests.
